segments.normalizedSource: ```objective-c -(OSStatus)createMIDIDestination:(MIDIClientRef)client named:(CFStringRef)name protocol:(MIDIProtocolID)protocol dest:(MIDIEndpointRef *)outDest { __block MIDIMessageFIFO *msgQueue = messageQueue.get(); const auto status = MIDIDestinationCreateWithProtocol(client, name, protocol, outDest, ^(const MIDIEventList * _Nonnull evtlist, void * _Nullable srcConnRefCon) { if (evtlist->numPackets > 0 && msgQueue) { auto pkt = &evtlist->packet[0]; for (int i = 0; i < evtlist->numPackets; ++i) { if (!msgQueue->push(evtlist->packet[i])) { msgQueue->push(evtlist->packet[i]); } pkt = MIDIEventPacketNext(pkt); } } }); return status; } ```
